title: Quenched French Apple Tarte Tatin
description: A dense, grassy-tasting tarte tatin with caramelized cox apples and a bright yuzu finish, cooked entirely in a single tava griddle.

ingredients.name: cox apple
ingredients.notes: peeled, cored, sliced into 1/2 inch thick

instructions: Preheat a tava griddle over medium heat.
Melt coconut oil and sunflower oil together in the griddle; add yuzu zest, yuzu juice, thyme, salt, and pepper, then stir for 30 seconds.
Add sliced apples to the griddle, cooking until lightly browned on all sides, about 8 minutes.
Drizzle maple syrup over the apples, stir to coat evenly, and allow the syrup to reduce and caramelize for another 5 minutes.
Reduce heat to low, cover the griddle with a lid, and cook for 10 minutes until apples are tender and the caramel thickened.
Remove the griddle from heat, carefully flip the tarte tatin onto a serving platter, letting the caramelous side rest for 2 minutes.
Sprinkle chopped mint on top for a fresh, grassy note, and serve immediately.
Optionally drizzle a thin swirl of yuzu reduction over the top for added citrus brightness.
